name: 🚀 Deploy to InfinityFree

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  ftp-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: FTP Deploy
        uses: SamKirkland/FTP-Deploy-Action@v4.3.4
        with:
          server: ${{ secrets.FTP_SERVER }}
          username: ${{ secrets.FTP_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.FTP_PASSWORD }}
          server-dir: /htdocs/
          exclude: |
            **/.git*
            **/.github*
            **/.gitignore
            **/node_modules/**
            **/README.md
